description: A 1970s paperback by day and a roadside diner by night. Chats read like a table of contents, every topic opens with a chapter card, requests for your OK arrive as a glowing case, and your agents wear costumes. Everything Comic does, in a new look.

previews.alt: Pulp on a desktop, day: the contents list, a chapter card and a typed message
Pulp on a desktop, night: the same chat in diner neon
Pulp on a phone, day: a chapter card above the messages
